taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Subresource integrity and script provenance at mutable external script loads
controls.source_trace: Follow which external bytes execute, including fallback loaders and dynamically added scripts. Establish who can change the resource before assigning compromise impact.
controls.implementation_branch: Check module/preload and dynamic-loader paths independently; a verified initial script can load unverified descendants. For cross-origin resources include the actual CORS mode in the fixture. Establish a lower-trust publisher and executing fallback before claiming dependency compromise rather than missing defense in depth.
controls.operational_method: When integrity metadata contains several supported algorithms, derive the strongest supported algorithm and compare against its candidate digest set; matching a weaker digest does not rescue a failed stronger supported set. Retain exact fetched response bytes and the actual browser load result. Separate unsupported algorithms, CORS rejection and integrity failure in diagnostics before attributing an altered-script execution to SRI.
controls.controlled_verification: On an owned mirror replace one script with a harmless altered marker and compare the intended hash match, mismatch rejection and fallback behavior.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Missing SRI alone is not a demonstrated vendor compromise; a changed script that never executes is not a provenance failure.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Pin or independently verify intended resources and retest normal loading, rejection and every fallback capable of executing code.
